title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. For each fold, one part is used as the validation set, and the remaining $$7$$ parts are used for training. This process is repeated $$8$$ times, each time with a different part as the validation set.

title: Hyperparameter Tuning
text: When tuning a hyperparameter, you test multiple values to find the best one. In this case, you are testing $$11$$ different values of the hyperparameter.

title: Calculating Total Models
text: Consider how many models are fit for each fold and how many hyperparameter values are tested. What is the total number of models?
